description: STARLUX inflight meal. Shockingly tender, flavorful beef, and tasty fruit. Walked around the cabin with a hot tea, which was a delight. The rest was classic airline food.
STARLUX inflight breakfast. Pork congee was the star of the show: super tasty, very fragrant and flavorful, with a great texture. The rest of the breakfast was standard.

Soup dumplings were so fire. Alongside: hot and sour soup (good, tasted like pepper), smashed cucumbers (a good fresh addition), hot cabbage (mid) and a milk tea. The rest was good but nothing special.

photos.alt: Bamboo steamer of soup dumplings with ginger, hot and sour soup, stir-fried cabbage and cucumbers on airport food-court trays
